title: Ming-3.0 TTS · public inference and serving path
date: 19 Oct code · 20 Oct 03:27 UTC Tiny serving docs · discovered 20 Oct
summary: Ming releases task-specific voice design, reference-voice synthesis and expressive delivery code; Tiny adds dialogue. September 24 checkpoint uploads predate this code release.
implication: The new SGLang-Omni recipe returns one finished waveform even with stream=true. Treat it as a serving option, not proof of incremental playback, full reference-task parity or measured speed.

title: Higgsfield · FLUX 3 Video Upscaler build updated
summary: A new upscaler build automatically replaces the previous one. Higgsfield attributes detail improvements to BFL and claims shorter processing and fewer credits.
implication: Retest matching footage before assuming a quality/cost gain. Exact rates are shown before generation; no measured comparison or output test here.

title: OpenArt · Mirelo SFX 2.0 listed
date: Observed 19 Oct 2026 · exact integration date unknown
summary: Official model page and directory now list Mirelo SFX 2.0 for video sound replacement and dialogue-focused output. The underlying Mirelo release is October 14.
implication: A new listed option for finishing audio inside OpenArt. Credits, plan availability and output were not tested; don't infer the integration date from this observation.

title: Runway · Mirelo SFX 2.0 and Drama 3 in MCP
summary: Runway dates Mirelo SFX 2.0 integration October 15, producing a separate audio track. Drama 3 directed voiceovers arrived October 14; BiRefNet v2 background removal October 15.
implication: These are access/integration changes, not new underlying model launches. No request, timing or sound-quality test was performed.

title: ElevenLabs · Instant Soundtracks
summary: Video-conditioned scoring and SFX can be exported as separate tracks. The October 19 page edit does not establish a second feature release.
implication: A useful counterpart to Mirelo's audio replacement. Test synchronization separately from sound quality; no independent comparison here.

title: ComfyUI · MOSS support and crash fix
summary: Version 0.42 adds MOSS-image support and a Krea 3 partner node. The next patch fixes a MOSS-template crash for some users.
implication: Model access and integration maturity are separate checks. No local upgrade or generation run performed.

title: Adobe · Lightroom mobile gets Open Eyes and Generative Expand
summary: Adobe introduces a blink-correction quick action and image outpainting on mobile. Open Eyes can use other library photos to guide eye appearance.
implication: Useful for portrait repair and reframing assets. Vendor-described availability and quality; no image test. This is a workflow release, not a comparative SOTA result.

title: Cartesia · previously reported Sonic sunset is imminent
date: July 2026 notice · sunset after 20 Oct; rechecked 19 Oct
summary: Current changelog still names Sonic-2, Sonic-turbo and Sonic-3-2025-10-27 for retirement after October 20.
implication: Reminder for affected integrations, not new news. Exact cutoff time/timezone is unspecified; no account use inspected.

title: Higgsfield · previously reported API migration
date: Deadline 31 Oct 2026 · rechecked 19 Oct; notice date unknown
summary: Official status banner still requests migration from platform.higgsfield.ai to api.higgsfield.ai.
implication: If affected, check application, SDK and environment base URLs. Last-updated status time is not the notice publication time.

title: Legacy Luma Ray 2 nodes · October 24 endpoint removal
date: 02 Oct 2026 Comfy change · discovered 14 Oct; removal 24 Oct · prior notice retained
summary: Comfy's merged deprecation change and legacy-node guides say the Ray 2 endpoints used by its old image/text-to-video nodes are removed October 24. The guides point to separate Ray 3.2 nodes.
implication: Inspect saved workflows for legacy nodes before the deadline. This is Comfy's integration guidance; Luma-owned confirmation and a drop-in migration were not verified. Do not infer all Luma services are ending.

title: Hume · TTS and EVI API sunset
date: 02 Oct 2026 · notice; discovered 12 Oct · prior notice retained
summary: Hume says TTS and EVI API access ends 13 November 2026 at 12:01 a.m. EST. Account data will be permanently deleted after 13 November.
implication: An older notice missing from the previous review, not a new launch. Workflows using these APIs need a replacement and a plan for needed account data before the deadline. The notice says both APIs remain fully supported until then.
